verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items is a fair question for a code-review SaaS that manages queues of pull requests, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no true multi-select or batch action. Triage offers a cross-repository queue with views and filters, but its actions (review, repair, reassign, merge, close) are described for a single pull request. Org-wide central configuration and path or glob instructions are adjacent configuration features, not bulk operations, so they earn no credit.
